lines.gurmukhi: ਪ੍ਰਭਾਤੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੪ ॥
lines.transliteration: prabhaatee mahalaa 4 ||
lines.translation: Prabhaatee, Fourth Mehl:

lines.gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਸਤਿਗੁਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਦ੍ਰਿੜਾਇਓ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਹਮ ਮੁਏ ਜੀਵੇ ਹਰਿ ਜਪਿਭਾ ॥
lines.transliteration: gur satigur naam driRaaio har har ham mue jeeve har japibhaa ||
lines.translation: The Guru, the True Guru, has implanted the Naam, the Name of the Lord within me. I was dead, but chanting the Name of the Lord, Har, Har, I have been brought back to life.

lines.gurmukhi: ਧਨੁ ਧੰਨੁ ਗੁਰੂ ਗੁਰੁ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਪੂਰਾ ਬਿਖੁ ਡੁਬਦੇ ਬਾਹ ਦੇਇ ਕਢਿਭਾ ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: dhan dha(n)n guroo gur satigur pooraa bikh dubade baah dei kadhibhaa ||1||
lines.translation: Blessed, blessed is the Guru, the Guru, the Perfect True Guru; He reached out to me with His Arm, and pulled me up and out of the ocean of poison. ||1||

lines.gurmukhi: ਜਪਿ ਮਨ ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮੁ ਅਰਧਾਂਭਾ ॥
lines.transliteration: jap man raam naam aradhaa(n)bhaa ||
lines.translation: O mind, meditate and worship the Lord's Name.

lines.gurmukhi: ਉਪਜੰਪਿ ਉਪਾਇ ਨ ਪਾਈਐ ਕਤਹੂ ਗੁਰਿ ਪੂਰੈ ਹਰਿ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਲਾਭਾ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
lines.transliteration: upaja(n)p upaai na paaeeai katahoo gur poorai har prabh laabhaa ||1|| rahaau ||
lines.translation: God is never found, even by making all sorts of new efforts. The Lord God is obtained only through the Perfect Guru. ||1||Pause||

lines.gurmukhi: ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮੁ ਰਸੁ ਰਾਮ ਰਸਾਇਣੁ ਰਸੁ ਪੀਆ ਗੁਰਮਤਿ ਰਸਭਾ ॥
lines.transliteration: raam naam ras raam rasaain ras peeaa guramat rasabhaa ||
lines.translation: The Sublime Essence of the Lord's Name is the source of nectar and bliss; drinking in this Sublime Essence, following the Guru's Teachings, I have become happy.

lines.gurmukhi: ਲੋਹ ਮਨੂਰ ਕੰਚਨੁ ਮਿਲਿ ਸੰਗਤਿ ਹਰਿ ਉਰ ਧਾਰਿਓ ਗੁਰਿ ਹਰਿਭਾ ॥੨॥
lines.transliteration: loh manoor ka(n)chan mil sa(n)gat har ur dhaario gur haribhaa ||2||
lines.translation: Even iron slag is transformed into gold, joining the Lord's Congregation. Through the Guru, the Lord's Light is enshrined within the heart. ||2||

lines.gurmukhi: ਹਉਮੈ ਬਿਖਿਆ ਨਿਤ ਲੋਭਿ ਲੁਭਾਨੇ ਪੁਤ ਕਲਤ ਮੋਹਿ ਲੁਭਿਭਾ ॥
lines.transliteration: haumai bikhiaa nit lobh lubhaane put kalat mohi lubhibhaa ||
lines.translation: Those who are continually lured by greed, egotism and corruption, who are lured away by emotional attachment to their children and spouse

lines.gurmukhi: ਤਿਨ ਪਗ ਸੰਤ ਨ ਸੇਵੇ ਕਬਹੂ ਤੇ ਮਨਮੁਖ ਭੂੰਭਰ ਭਰਭਾ ॥੩॥
lines.transliteration: tin pag sa(n)t na seve kabahoo te manamukh bhoo(n)bhar bharabhaa ||3||
lines.translation: - they never serve at the feet of the Saints; those self-willed manmukhs are filled with ashes. ||3||

lines.gurmukhi: ਤੁਮਰੇ ਗੁਨ ਤੁਮ ਹੀ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਜਾਨਹੁ ਹਮ ਪਰੇ ਹਾਰਿ ਤੁਮ ਸਰਨਭਾ ॥
lines.transliteration: tumare gun tum hee prabh jaanahu ham pare haar tum saranabhaa ||
lines.translation: O God, You alone know Your Glorious Virtues; I have grown weary - I seek Your Sanctuary.

lines.gurmukhi: ਜਿਉ ਜਾਨਹੁ ਤਿਉ ਰਾਖਹੁ ਸੁਆਮੀ ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕੁ ਦਾਸੁ ਤੁਮਨਭਾ ॥੪॥੬॥ ਛਕਾ ੧ ॥
lines.transliteration: jiu jaanahu tiu raakhahu suaamee jan naanak daas tumanabhaa ||4||6|| chhakaa 1 ||
lines.translation: As You know best, You preserve and protect me, O my Lord and Master; servant Nanak is Your slave. ||4||6|| First Set of Six||

lines.gurmukhi: ਪ੍ਰਭਾਤੀ ਬਿਭਾਸ ਪੜਤਾਲ ਮਹਲਾ ੪ ॥
lines.transliteration: prabhaatee bibhaas paRataal mahalaa 4 ||
lines.translation: Prabhaatee, Bibhaas, Partaal, Fourth Mehl:

lines.gurmukhi: ੴ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
lines.transliteration: ikOankaar satigur prasaad ||
lines.translation: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

lines.gurmukhi: ਜਪਿ ਮਨ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਨਿਧਾਨ ॥
lines.transliteration: jap man har har naam nidhaan ||
lines.translation: O mind, meditate on the Treasure of the Name of the Lord, Har, Har.

lines.gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਦਰਗਹ ਪਾਵਹਿ ਮਾਨ ॥
lines.transliteration: har daragah paavahi maan ||
lines.translation: You shall be honored in the Court of the Lord.

lines.gurmukhi: ਜਿਨਿ ਜਪਿਆ ਤੇ ਪਾਰਿ ਪਰਾਨ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
lines.transliteration: jin japiaa te paar paraan ||1|| rahaau ||
lines.translation: Those who chant and meditate shall be carried across to the other shore. ||1||Pause||

lines.gurmukhi: ਸੁਨਿ ਮਨ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਕਰਿ ਧਿਆਨੁ ॥
lines.transliteration: sun man har har naam kar dhiaan ||
lines.translation: Listen, O mind: meditate on the Name of the Lord, Har, Har.

lines.gurmukhi: ਸੁਨਿ ਮਨ ਹਰਿ ਕੀਰਤਿ ਅਠਸਠਿ ਮਜਾਨੁ ॥
lines.transliteration: sun man har keerat athasath majaan ||
lines.translation: Listen, O mind: the Kirtan of the Lord's Praises is equal to bathing at the sixty-eight sacred shrines of pilgrimage.

lines.gurmukhi: ਸੁਨਿ ਮਨ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਪਾਵਹਿ ਮਾਨੁ ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: sun man guramukh paavahi maan ||1||
lines.translation: Listen, O mind: as Gurmukh, you shall be blessed with honor. ||1||

lines.gurmukhi: ਜਪਿ ਮਨ ਪਰਮੇਸੁਰੁ ਪਰਧਾਨੁ ॥
lines.transliteration: jap man paramesur paradhaan ||
lines.translation: O mind, chant and meditate on the Supreme Transcendent Lord God.

lines.gurmukhi: ਖਿਨ ਖੋਵੈ ਪਾਪ ਕੋਟਾਨ ॥
lines.transliteration: khin khovai paap kotaan ||
lines.translation: Millions of sins shall be destroyed in an instant.

lines.gurmukhi: ਮਿਲੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਹਰਿ ਭਗਵਾਨ ॥੨॥੧॥੭॥
lines.transliteration: mil naanak har bhagavaan ||2||1||7||
lines.translation: O Nanak, you shall meet with the Lord God. ||2||1||7||

lines.gurmukhi: ਪ੍ਰਭਾਤੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ਬਿਭਾਸ ॥
lines.transliteration: prabhaatee mahalaa 5 bibhaas ||
lines.translation: Prabhaatee, Fifth Mehl, Bibhaas:

lines.gurmukhi: ੴ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
lines.transliteration: ikOankaar satigur prasaad ||
lines.translation: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

lines.gurmukhi: ਮਨੁ ਹਰਿ ਕੀਆ ਤਨੁ ਸਭੁ ਸਾਜਿਆ ॥
lines.transliteration: man har keeaa tan sabh saajiaa ||
lines.translation: The Lord created the mind, and fashioned the entire body.

lines.gurmukhi: ਪੰਚ ਤਤ ਰਚਿ ਜੋਤਿ ਨਿਵਾਜਿਆ ॥
lines.transliteration: pa(n)ch tat rach jot nivaajiaa ||
lines.translation: From the five elements, He formed it, and infused His Light within it.

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਿਹਜਾ ਧਰਤਿ ਬਰਤਨ ਕਉ ਪਾਨੀ ॥
lines.transliteration: sihajaa dharat baratan kau paanee ||
lines.translation: He made the earth its bed, and water for it to use.

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਿਮਖ ਨ ਵਿਸਾਰਹੁ ਸੇਵਹੁ ਸਾਰਿਗਪਾਨੀ ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: nimakh na visaarahu sevahu saarigapaanee ||1||
lines.translation: Do not forget Him for an instant; serve the Lord of the World. ||1||

lines.gurmukhi: ਮਨ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਸੇਵਿ ਹੋਇ ਪਰਮ ਗਤੇ ॥
lines.transliteration: man satigur sev hoi param gate ||
lines.translation: O mind, serve the True Guru, and obtain the supreme status.

lines.gurmukhi: ਹਰਖ ਸੋਗ ਤੇ ਰਹਹਿ ਨਿਰਾਰਾ ਤਾਂ ਤੂ ਪਾਵਹਿ ਪ੍ਰਾਨਪਤੇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
lines.transliteration: harakh sog te rahahi niraaraa taa(n) too paavahi praanapate ||1|| rahaau ||
lines.translation: If you remain unattached and unaffected by sorrow and joy, then you shall find the Lord of Life. ||1||Pause||

lines.gurmukhi: ਕਾਪੜ ਭੋਗ ਰਸ ਅਨਿਕ ਭੁੰਚਾਏ ॥
lines.transliteration: kaapaR bhog ras anik bhu(n)chaae ||
lines.translation: He makes all the various pleasures, clothes and foods for you to enjoy.

lines.gurmukhi: ਮਾਤ ਪਿਤਾ ਕੁਟੰਬ ਸਗਲ ਬਨਾਏ ॥
lines.transliteration: maat pitaa kuta(n)b sagal banaae ||
lines.translation: He made your mother, father and all relatives.

lines.gurmukhi: ਰਿਜਕੁ ਸਮਾਹੇ ਜਲਿ ਥਲਿ ਮੀਤ ॥
lines.transliteration: rijak samaahe jal thal meet ||
lines.translation: He provides sustenance to all, in the water and on the land, O friend.

lines.gurmukhi: ਸੋ ਹਰਿ ਸੇਵਹੁ ਨੀਤਾ ਨੀਤ ॥੨॥
lines.transliteration: so har sevahu neetaa neet ||2||
lines.translation: So serve the Lord, forever and ever. ||2||

lines.gurmukhi: ਤਹਾ ਸਖਾਈ ਜਹ ਕੋਇ ਨ ਹੋਵੈ ॥
lines.transliteration: tahaa sakhaaee jah koi na hovai ||
lines.translation: He shall be your Helper and Support there, where no one else can help you.

lines.gurmukhi: ਕੋਟਿ ਅਪ੍ਰਾਧ ਇਕ ਖਿਨ ਮਹਿ ਧੋਵੈ ॥
lines.transliteration: kot apraadh ik khin mahi dhovai ||
lines.translation: He washes away millions of sins in an instant.

lines.gurmukhi: ਦਾਤਿ ਕਰੈ ਨਹੀ ਪਛੋੁਤਾਵੈ ॥
lines.transliteration: daat karai nahee pachhoutaavai ||
lines.translation: He bestows His Gifts, and never regrets them.

lines.gurmukhi: ਏਕਾ ਬਖਸ ਫਿਰਿ ਬਹੁਰਿ ਨ ਬੁਲਾਵੈ ॥੩॥
lines.transliteration: ekaa bakhas phir bahur na bulaavai ||3||
lines.translation: He forgives, once and for all, and never asks for one's account again. ||3||

lines.gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਆਪੁ ਧਰਿਓ ਹਰਿ ਜਨ ਮਹਿ ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕੁ ਹਰਿ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਇਕਫਾ ॥੪॥੫॥
lines.transliteration: har har aap dhario har jan mahi jan naanak har prabh ikaphaa ||4||5||
lines.translation: The Lord, Har, Har, has enshrined Himself within His humble servant. O Nanak, the Lord God and His servant are one and the same. ||4||5||
